annotation.title_clean: Amendments adopted by the European Parliament on 14 June 2023 on the proposal for a regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: Amendments adopted by the European Parliament on 14 June 2023 on the proposal for a regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament's first-reading amendments (14 June 2023) to the Commission's proposed EU AI Act, published in the Official Journal. It broadens the prohibitions (biometric categorisation, emotion recognition, predictive policing, real-time remote biometric identification) and revises the high-risk rules, introduces general principles and AI literacy, and exempts open-source components. It also addresses robots and safety components of products.
key_provisions_or_claims: Expands prohibited AI practices, including real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces, emotion recognition and predictive policing
Redefines the AI system concept and adds general principles for trustworthy, human-centric AI
Refines high-risk classification with a significant-risk test and a notification procedure for Annex III systems
Strengthens accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity requirements for high-risk systems, with human oversight
Notes that autonomous robots and safety components of products such as machinery and medical devices must operate safely, and links the Act to sectoral product law
